#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Register once, execute once, and replay frozen HH101 development evidence."""
import argparse
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from pathlib import Path
from sara_engine.evaluation.casas_longitudinal import ARMS, extract, support, compare
from sara_engine.evaluation.motion_temporal import digest, save
from sara_engine.utils.project_paths import project_path, raw_data_path, processed_data_path, model_path

PREFIX = 'casas_longitudinal'
CODE = ('src/sara_engine/evaluation/casas_longitudinal.py',
        'src/sara_engine/evaluation/delayed_sparse_counts.py',
        'src/sara_engine/evaluation/motion_temporal.py',
        'src/sara_engine/utils/project_paths.py',
        'scripts/eval/casas_longitudinal_comparison.py')
SOURCE_HASH = '7d9e976308e1cb5bc91cb39937848bfe073fc7b44c8a33cf166de203014b0091'


def main(mode):
    path = lambda suffix: processed_data_path('benchmark_fixtures', PREFIX+'_'+suffix+'_v1.json')
    archive = raw_data_path('r2_casas_longitudinal', 'source.zip')
    if mode == 'register':
        protocol = {
            'source': 'https://zenodo.org/records/15708568',
            'source_url': 'https://zenodo.org/records/15708568/files/labeled_data.zip?download=1',
            'source_sha256': SOURCE_HASH, 'member': 'labeled/hh101.csv',
            'attribution': 'Diane Cook and CASAS; Cook et al. (2013), CASAS: A smart home in a box, DOI 10.1109/MC.2012.328. Public research source; raw records not redistributed.',
            'independence': 'New WSU home, distinct from consumed UCI sources; externally annotated behavior, not direct physical occupancy measurement.',
            'selection': 'Aruba missing from current official bundle; HH101 is smallest numbered HH home, selected by file identity and date metadata, not label prevalence.',
            'prior_exposure': 'First data row was mistaken for header and displayed: 2012-07-20 10:38:54 OutsideDoor ON Step_Out begin. Entire first day excluded prospectively. Other inspection limited to file names and date counts (60 dates).',
            'train': '2012-07-21 <= cutoff and outcome < 2012-08-20',
            'development': '2012-08-20 <= cutoff and outcome < 2012-09-04',
            'sealed': '2012-09-04 onward, date/time fields only, no annotation or message access',
            'task': 'Sleep/Sleeping active at the first binary sensor event >=300s after cutoff and <=600s after cutoff; other actively annotated behavior is negative; missing annotation never means negative.',
            'annotation': 'Forward begin/end interval tracking, ends exclusive, max interval age 12h; active Sleep/Sleeping wins overlaps. Label eligibility is evaluator-only. This is conditional on future annotation coverage, not all-time occupancy detection.',
            'input': 'Exact current sensor identifier and binary ON/OFF/OPEN/CLOSE/CLOSED message, weekday and quarter-hour clock. Event notification state, not whole-home physical state. Continuous messages and annotations are never predictive inputs.',
            'history': 'Last 8 binary events; gaps 0..300s; no cross-split history; cutoff at most once per 60s; unresolved/late/unannotated/cross-split outcomes excluded and counted.',
            'support': 'Training >=500 examples/class on >=20 days/class; development >=200/class on >=10 days/class; >=10 current+clock groups with distinct joint histories and >=4 observations per opposing future label.',
            'arms': ARMS,
            'routes': '3 distinct changed integer count writes/outcome: global, shared current+clock, arm detail. Hierarchical prior strength8; 100000 total routes; 32 pending receipts.',
            'details': '5-minute current clock; unordered full history histogram; lag1/lag4 transition; joint adds gap bins <1,<10,<60,>=60 at lag1/lag4; constant gap sets both bins2; exact scalar_joint; training-only half-length outcome rotation.',
            'causality': 'Due-ordered receipt queue; no label supplier call before due; flush all due outcomes before next decision; frozen development zero writes.',
            'quality': 'Joint daily Brier >=.01 better and balanced accuracy >=.02 better than best current/current_fine/histogram/transition; constant-gap daily Brier loss >=.005; shuffled-outcome loss >=.01; scalar equivalence exact.',
            'resources': 'CPU-only sparse dictionaries, no GPU/matrices/global backpropagation. Pending/state ceilings fail closed. No physical energy claim.',
            'stop': 'Support failure stops before any arm training/scoring; thresholds, split and labels never retuned. No sealed test opening or production promotion in either outcome.'}
        preserved = {}
        for directory in ('data/processed/benchmark_fixtures', 'models'):
            for p in Path(project_path(directory)).rglob('*.json'):
                preserved[str(p.relative_to(project_path()))] = digest(p)
        save(path('protocol'), protocol)
        save(path('registration'), {'protocol_sha256':digest(path('protocol')),
                                  'code':{p:digest(project_path(p)) for p in CODE},
                                  'preserved':preserved})
        print('Registered before remaining sensor/annotation inspection')
        return
    reg = json.loads(Path(path('registration')).read_text())
    if digest(path('protocol')) != reg['protocol_sha256'] or digest(archive) != SOURCE_HASH:
        raise ValueError('Frozen source/protocol differs')
    amendment = Path(path('parser_amendment'))
    code = json.loads(amendment.read_text())['code'] if amendment.exists() else reg['code']
    for p,h in {**code, **reg['preserved']}.items():
        if digest(project_path(p)) != h:
            raise ValueError('Pinned code or old evidence differs: '+p)
    if mode == 'execute':
        save(path('repaired_execution' if amendment.exists() else 'execution'), {'started':True})
    examples, audit = extract(archive)
    report = {'extraction':audit, 'support':support(examples), 'test_opened':False}
    if report['support']['passed']:
        comparison, checkpoints = compare(examples)
        report['comparison'] = comparison
        report['model_sha256'] = {}
        for arm,state in checkpoints.items():
            destination = model_path('casas_hh101', arm+'_v1.json')
            if mode == 'execute':
                save(destination, state)
            elif json.loads(Path(destination).read_text()) != state:
                raise ValueError('Published count checkpoint differs')
            report['model_sha256'][arm] = digest(destination)
    if mode == 'execute':
        save(path('result'), report)
    elif json.loads(json.dumps(report)) != json.loads(Path(path('result')).read_text()):
        raise ValueError('Fresh-process replay differs')
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('mode', choices=('register','execute','replay'))
    main(parser.parse_args().mode)

"""Fresh HH102 observed kitchen-notification task; annotations stay unused."""
from collections import Counter, deque
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from io import TextIOWrapper
from zipfile import ZipFile
from sara_engine.evaluation.casas_longitudinal import Example, gap_bin

START = datetime(2011, 6, 15)
TRAIN_END = datetime(2011, 7, 15)
TEST_START = datetime(2011, 7, 30)


def extract_lines(lines):
    history, pending = deque(maxlen=8), deque()
    examples = {'train': [], 'development': []}
    audit = Counter()
    previous = None
    last_cutoff = None
    for line in lines:
        fields = line.rstrip('\r\n').split(',', 4)
        if len(fields) < 2:
            raise ValueError('Missing date/time fields')
        day = datetime.strptime(fields[0], '%Y-%m-%d')
        if day >= TEST_START:
            audit['sealed_timestamp_only_rows'] += 1
            continue
        if day < START:
            audit['excluded_rows'] += 1
            continue
        stamp = fields[0] + ' ' + fields[1]
        t = datetime.strptime(stamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f' if '.' in fields[1] else '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
        if previous is not None and t < previous:
            raise ValueError('Source clock regressed')
        previous = t
        if len(fields) < 4:
            raise ValueError('Missing sensor/message fields')
        audit['opened_rows'] += 1
        if fields[3] not in ('ON', 'OFF', 'OPEN', 'CLOSE', 'CLOSED'):
            audit['nonbinary_rows'] += 1
            continue
        event = (fields[2], fields[3])
        while pending and pending[0][0]+timedelta(seconds=300) <= t:
            cutoff, old_history, gaps = pending.popleft()
            if (t-cutoff).total_seconds() > 600:
                audit['late_outcomes'] += 1
                continue
            if (cutoff < TRAIN_END) != (t < TRAIN_END):
                audit['cross_split_outcomes'] += 1
                continue
            label = int(event[0].lower().startswith('kitchen') and event[1]=='ON')
            split = 'train' if cutoff < TRAIN_END else 'development'
            examples[split].append(Example(cutoff,t,old_history,gaps,label))
        history.append((t,event))
        if last_cutoff is not None and (t-last_cutoff).total_seconds() < 60:
            continue
        last_cutoff = t
        if len(history)!=8 or (history[0][0]<TRAIN_END)!=(t<TRAIN_END):
            continue
        intervals = [(b[0]-a[0]).total_seconds() for a,b in zip(history,list(history)[1:])]
        if any(not 0<=d<=300 for d in intervals):
            audit['interrupted_histories'] += 1
            continue
        pending.append((t,tuple(v for _,v in history),tuple(gap_bin(d) for d in intervals)))
        if len(pending)>16:
            raise ValueError('Pending extraction capacity exceeded')
    audit['unresolved_outcomes'] = len(pending)
    return examples,dict(audit)


def extract(archive):
    with ZipFile(archive) as z:
        info = z.getinfo('labeled/hh102.csv')
        if info.file_size>100_000_000:
            raise ValueError('Source size bound exceeded')
        with z.open(info) as stream:
            return extract_lines(TextIOWrapper(stream,encoding='utf-8'))

            'attribution':'Cook et al. (2013), CASAS: A smart home in a box, DOI 10.1109/MC.2012.328; public research source, raw data not redistributed.',
            'independence':'Fresh distinct household; no HH102 input/outcome inspection before registration. Same acquisition archive, different source identity from HH101. No cross-household generalization claim.',
            'motivation':'HH101 Sleep task failed frozen support: sparse observable nighttime events. Retain that failure. New future physically recorded notification target uses no activity annotation or imputed occupancy.',
            'metadata_only_exposure':'62 dates, 2011-06-15 through 2011-08-15, no timestamp inversions; no sensor/message/annotation values inspected.',
            'task':'Kitchen-prefix sensor ON at the first binary notification 300-600 seconds after cutoff; negative is any other observed binary notification, never missing data or no-event absence.',
            'train':'2011-06-15 through 2011-07-14','development':'2011-07-15 through 2011-07-29','sealed':'2011-07-30 onward: date fields only; no sensor/message/annotation parsing',
            'input':'Raw current sensor ID and binary message, weekday and quarter-hour clock, eight binary events with adjacent gaps 0..300s; current notification state, not complete household physical state. Annotations and continuous sensors never inputs.',
            'eligibility':'At most one cutoff per60s; purge cross-split history/outcomes and interrupted histories. First event >=300s later must arrive within600s. Conditional on follow-up observation, not absence prediction.',
            'support':'Training >=500/class on >=20 days/class; development >=200/class on >=10 days/class; >=10 exact current+clock groups with distinct joint histories and >=4 observations per opposite future label.',
            'arms':ARMS,

            'quality':'Joint daily Brier improves >=.01 and balanced accuracy >=.02 versus best current/current_fine/histogram/transition; constant gap loss >=.005 and outcome-shuffle loss >=.01 daily Brier; exact scalar equivalence.',
            'scope':'CPU scalar sparse local readout feasibility; no matrices/GPU/global gradient; no SNN/energy/health/production claim. No test opening whether gates pass or fail.'}
        preserved = {str(p.relative_to(project_path())):digest(p)
                     for directory in ('data/processed/benchmark_fixtures','models')
                     for p in Path(project_path(directory)).rglob('*.json')}
        save(path('protocol'),protocol)
        save(path('registration'),{'protocol_sha256':digest(path('protocol')),
                                   'code':{p:digest(project_path(p)) for p in CODE},'preserved':preserved})
        print('Fresh HH102 task registered before sensor/message inspection')
        return
    reg=json.loads(Path(path('registration')).read_text())
    if digest(path('protocol'))!=reg['protocol_sha256'] or digest(archive)!=SOURCE_HASH:
        raise ValueError('Source or protocol changed')
    for p,h in {**reg['code'],**reg['preserved']}.items():
        if digest(project_path(p))!=h:raise ValueError('Pinned evidence changed: '+p)
    if mode=='execute':save(path('execution'),{'started':True})
    examples,audit=extract(archive)
    report={'extraction':audit,'support':support(examples),'test_opened':False}
    if report['support']['passed']:
        comparison,checkpoints=compare(examples)

            target=model_path('casas_hh102',arm+'_v1.json')
            if mode=='execute':save(target,checkpoint)
            elif json.loads(Path(target).read_text())!=checkpoint:raise ValueError('Saved model replay differs')
            report['model_sha256'][arm]=digest(target)
    if mode=='execute':save(path('result'),report)
    elif json.loads(json.dumps(report))!=json.loads(Path(path('result')).read_text()):
        raise ValueError('Independent replay differs')
    print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))


if __name__=='__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('mode',choices=('register','execute','replay'))
    main(parser.parse_args().mode)

    code = json.loads(amendment.read_text())['code'] if amendment.exists() else reg['code']
    for p,h in {**code, **reg['preserved']}.items():
        if digest(project_path(p)) != h:
            raise ValueError('Pinned code or old evidence differs: '+p)
    if mode == 'execute':
        save(processed_data_path('benchmark_fixtures', PREFIX+'_repaired_execution_v2.json'), {'started':True})
    examples, audit = extract(archive)
    report = {'extraction':audit, 'support':support(examples), 'test_opened':False}
    if report['support']['passed']:
        comparison, checkpoints = compare(examples)
        report['comparison'] = comparison
        report['model_sha256'] = {}
        for arm,state in checkpoints.items():
            destination = model_path('casas_hh101', arm+'_v1.json')
            if mode == 'execute':
                save(destination, state)
            elif json.loads(Path(destination).read_text()) != state:
                raise ValueError('Published count checkpoint differs')
            report['model_sha256'][arm] = digest(destination)
    if mode == 'execute':
        save(path('result'), report)
    elif json.loads(json.dumps(report)) != json.loads(Path(path('result')).read_text()):
        raise ValueError('Fresh-process replay differs')
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('mode', choices=('register','execute','replay'))
    main(parser.parse_args().mode)
